fn getenv (key default)
    val := (getattr (import .libc) 'getenv) key
    if (val == null)
        default
    else
        String (val as rawstring)

fn string-contains? (s sub)
    local sz : i32 = (countof s)
    local subz : i32 = (countof sub)
    if (subz == 0) return true
    if (sz < subz) return false
    loop (i)
        if (i > (sz - subz))
            return false
        if ((s @ i) == (sub @ 0))
            local j := 0
            while (j < subz)
                if ((s @ (i + j)) != (sub @ j))
                    break
                j += 1
            if (j == subz)
                return true
        i + 1

fn string-trim (s)
    i := 0
    j := (countof s)
    while (i < j) and (((s @ i) == 32) or ((s @ i) == 9) or ((s @ i) == 10) or ((s @ i) == 13))
        i += 1
    while (j > i) and (((s @ (j - 1)) == 32) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 9) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 10) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 13))
        j -= 1
    s slice i j

fn split-string (s delim)
    out := (Array)
    start := 0
    dlen := (countof delim)
    loop (i)
        if (i >= (countof s))
            'append out (s slice start (countof s))
            break out
        if ((s slice i (i + dlen)) == delim)
            'append out (s slice start i)
            start := i + dlen
            i + dlen
        else
            i + 1

fn sha512-hex (s)
    ctx := SHA512_CTX
    SHA512_Init &ctx
    SHA512_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 64)
    SHA512_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    buf := StringBuffer
    for i in (range 64)
        val := (digest @ i) as u8
        hi := (val >> 4) & 0xF
        lo := val & 0xF
        buf .. (if (hi < 10) (tostring (hi + 48)) (tostring (hi - 10 + 65)))
        buf .. (if (lo < 10) (tostring (lo + 48)) (tostring (lo - 10 + 65)))
    buf as String

fn current-time-seconds ()
    tv := (array i64 2)
    gettimeofday tv null
    ((tv @ 0) as f64) + (((tv @ 1) as f64) / 1000000.0)

fn SSE (key val)
    "data: " .. (build-json (table key = val)) .. "\n\n"

fn build-json (val)
    switch (typeof val)
    case String
        '"' .. (val as String) .. '"'
    case boolean
        if (val as boolean) "true" else "false"
    case integer
        tostring (val as integer)
    case real
        tostring (val as real)
    case null
        "null"
    case table
        buf := "{"
        first := true
        for k v in (val as table)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= build-json k
            buf ..= ":"
            buf ..= build-json v
        buf .. "}"
    case array
        buf := "["
        first := true
        for v in (val as array)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= build-json v
        buf .. "]"
    default
        "null"

fn json-parse-skip-ws (s idx)
    while (idx < (countof s))
        c := s @ idx
        if (c != 32) and (c != 9) and (c != 10) and (c != 13)
            break
        idx + 1

fn json-parse-string (s idx)
    if ((s @ idx) != 34) return ('null null) idx
    idx += 1
    buf := StringBuffer
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('string (buf as String)) idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c == 34) break ('string (buf as String)) (idx + 1)
        if (c == 92)
            if (idx + 1 < (countof s))
                n := s @ (idx + 1)
                if (n == 110) buf ..= "\n"
                elseif (n == 114) buf ..= "\r"
                elseif (n == 116) buf ..= "\t"
                elseif (n == 34) buf ..= '"'
                elseif (n == 92) buf ..= "\\"
                else buf ..= (tostring n)
                idx := idx + 2
            else idx + 1
        else
            buf ..= (tostring c)
            idx + 1

fn json-parse-number (s idx)
    start := idx
    is-float := false
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c >= 48) and (c <= 57) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 45) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 46)
            is-float := true
            idx + 1
        elseif (c == 69) or (c == 101)
            is-float := true
            if ((idx + 1) < (countof s))
                n := s @ (idx + 1)
                if (n == 43) or (n == 45) idx + 2
                else idx + 1
            else idx + 1
        else break idx
    str := s slice start idx
    if is-float
        val := (atof (str as rawstring))
        ('real val) idx
    else
        val := (atoi (str as rawstring))
        ('integer val) idx

fn json-parse-value (s idx)
    idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
    if (idx >= (countof s)) return ('null null) idx
    c := s @ idx
    if (c == 34)
        json-parse-string s idx
    elseif (c == 123)
        idx += 1
        obj := (table)
        loop (idx)
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 125) break ('table obj) (idx + 1)
            key kidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s kidx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 58) idx := json-parse-skip-ws s (idx + 1)
            val vidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := vidx
            if ((typeof key) == String)
                obj @ (key as String) = val
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44)
                idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 91)
        idx += 1
        arr := (Array)
        loop (idx)
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('array arr) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 93) break ('array arr) (idx + 1)
            val vidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := vidx
            'append arr val
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44)
                idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 116)
        if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "true") ('boolean true) (idx + 4)
        else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 102)
        if ((s slice idx (idx + 5)) == "false") ('boolean false) (idx + 5)
        else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 110)
        if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "null") ('null null) (idx + 4)
        else ('null null) idx
    else
        json-parse-number s idx

fn parse-json (s)
    val idx := json-parse-value s 0
    val

fn redis-send (host port command args)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return ""
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return ""
    
    req := "*" .. (tostring (1 + (countof args))) .. "\r\n$" .. (tostring (countof command)) .. "\r\n" .. command .. "\r\n"
    for arg in args
        s := (arg as String)
        req ..= "$" .. (tostring (countof s)) .. "\r\n" .. s .. "\r\n"
    
    send fd (req as rawstring) (countof req) 0
    
    buf := StringBuffer
    tmp := (array i8 4096)
    loop
        n := recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 4096 0
        if (n <= 0) break
        buf .. (String (tmp as rawstring) n)
    close fd
    buf as String

fn redis-get (host port key)
    data := redis-send host port "GET" (arrayof String key)
    if ((countof data) > 1) and (data @ 0) == 36
        parts := (split-string (data slice 1 (countof data)) "\r\n")
        if ((countof parts) > 1) parts @ 1 else ""
    else ""

fn redis-setex (host port key seconds value)
    redis-send host port "SETEX" (arrayof String key (tostring seconds) value)

fn redis-pipeline (host port cmds)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return ""
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return ""
    req := ""
    for cmd in cmds
        command := cmd @ 0
        args := cmd @ 1
        req ..= "*" .. (tostring (1 + (countof args))) .. "\r\n$" .. (tostring (countof command)) .. "\r\n" .. command .. "\r\n"
        for arg in args
            s := (arg as String)
            req ..= "$" .. (tostring (countof s)) .. "\r\n" .. s .. "\r\n"
    send fd (req as rawstring) (countof req) 0
    close fd

fn curl-post (url headers body)
    curl := curl_easy_init
    if (curl == null) return ""
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_URL url
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POST 1
    header_list := curl_slist_append null "Content-Type: application/json"
    for h in headers
        header_list := curl_slist_append header_list h
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER header_list
    response-buf := StringBuffer
    fn write-callback (ptr size nmemb userdata)
        real-size := size * nmemb
        str := String (ptr as rawstring) real-size
        buf := (bitcast userdata StringBuffer)
        buf .. str
        real-size as i32
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION write-callback
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEDATA (response-buf as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS (body as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDSIZE (countof body)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_TIMEOUT 60L
    res := curl_easy_perform curl
    result := response-buf as String
    if (res != CURLE_OK) result = ""
    curl_slist_free_all header_list
    curl_easy_cleanup curl
    result

fn exa-search (query)
    payload := build-json (table
        query = query
        numResults = 100
        type = "auto"
        contents = (table text = true context = (table maxCharacters = 20000))
    )
    headers := (arrayof String "x-api-key: " .. (getenv "EXA_API_KEY" "") "accept: application/json")
    body := curl-post "https://api.exa.ai/search" headers payload
    if ((countof body) == 0) return (table)
    data := parse-json body
    if ((typeof data) == table) data else (table)

fn exa-contents (urls)
    payload := build-json (table
        urls = urls
        text = (table maxCharacters = 5000)
    )
    headers := (arrayof String "x-api-key: " .. (getenv "EXA_API_KEY" "") "accept: application/json")
    body := curl-post "https://api.exa.ai/contents" headers payload
    if ((countof body) == 0) return (table context = "")
    parse-json body

fn cerebras-request (messages)
    payload := build-json (table
        model = "zai-glm-4.7"
        messages = messages
        stream = false
        max_completion_tokens = 8192
        temperature = 0.7
    )
    headers := (arrayof String "Authorization: Bearer " .. (getenv "CEREBRAS_API_KEY" ""))
    body := curl-post "https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/chat/completions" headers payload
    if ((countof body) == 0) return "" ""
    data := parse-json body
    response := ""
    reasoning := ""
    if ((typeof data) == table)
        choices := data @ "choices"
        if ((typeof choices) == array) and ((countof choices) > 0)
            msg := (choices @ 0) @ "message"
            if ((typeof msg) == table)
                response := msg @ "content" as String
                if (('key? msg "reasoning")) reasoning := msg @ "reasoning" as String
    response reasoning

fn mysql-build-packet (seq payload)
    len := (countof payload)
    if (len > 16777215) len := 16777215
    header := (array i8 4)
    (header @ 0) = (len & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 1) = ((len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 2) = ((len >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 3) = (seq & 0xFF) as i8
    String (header as rawstring 4) .. payload

fn singlestore-send (host port user pwd db query)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return -1
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return -1
    
    send fd "\n" 1 0
    recv fd (array i8 256) 256 0
    
    auth-packet := "\x00\xa6\x00\x00\x01" .. "\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00" .. user .. "\x00" .. (sha512-hex pwd) .. "\x00" .. db .. "\x00"
    send fd (auth-packet as rawstring) (countof auth-packet) 0
    recv fd (array i8 256) 256 0
    
    com-query := "\x03" .. query
    pkt := mysql-build-packet 0 com-query
    send fd (pkt as rawstring) (countof pkt) 0
    
    recv fd (array i8 256) 256 0
    close fd
    0

fn main ()
    server-fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    opt := 1
    setsockopt server-fd SOL_SOCKET SO_REUSEADDR (opt as rawstring) (sizeof opt)
    
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons 5000
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl INADDR_ANY
    
    bind server-fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr)
    listen server-fd 128
    
    epfd := epoll_create1 0
    event := epoll_event
    event.events = EPOLLIN
    event.data.fd = server-fd
    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD server-fd event
    
    clients := (table)
    
    loop
        events := (array epoll_event 32)
        nfds := epoll_wait epfd events 32 1000
        if (nfds < 0) break
        
        for i in (range nfds)
            ev := events @ i
            fd := ev.data.fd
            
            if (fd == server-fd)
                client-addr := sockaddr_in
                len := (sizeof sockaddr_in)
                client-fd := accept server-fd (client-addr as rawstring) len
                if (client-fd >= 0)
                    flags := fcntl client-fd F_GETFL 0
                    fcntl client-fd F_SETFL (flags | O_NONBLOCK)
                    
                    c-event := epoll_event
                    c-event.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLOUT | EPOLLET
                    c-event.data.fd = client-fd
                    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD client-fd c-event
                    
                    clients @ client-fd = (table
                        buffer = ""
                        state = "read"
                        response = ""
                        sse-queue = (Array)
                        step = 0
                        session-id = ""
                        message = ""
                        start-time = 0.0
                        meta = (table)
                    )
            else
                client := clients @ fd
                if ((ev.events & EPOLLHUP) != 0) or ((ev.events & EPOLLERR) != 0)
                    close fd
                    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_DEL fd null
                    'remove clients fd
                
                elseif ((ev.events & EPOLLIN) != 0) and (client.state == "read")
                    tmp := (array i8 4096)
                    n := recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 4096 0
                    if (n <= 0)
                        close fd
                        epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_DEL fd null
                        'remove clients fd
                    else
                        client.buffer .. (String (tmp as rawstring) n)
                        if ((string-contains? client.buffer "\r\n\r\n"))
                            parts := (split-string client.buffer "\r\n\r\n")
                            if ((countof parts) >= 2)
                                headers := split-string (parts @ 0) "\r\n"
                                body := parts @ 1
                                if ((countof headers) > 0)
                                    req-parts := split-string (headers @ 0) " "
                                    if ((countof req-parts) >= 2)
                                        method := req-parts @ 0
                                        path := req-parts @ 1
                                        
                                        if (method == "GET")
                                            if (path == "/")
                                                client.response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n<html><body>OK</body></html>"
                                                client.state = "write"
                                            elseif (path == "/health")
                                                h := build-json (table
                                                    flask = "ok"
                                                    dragonfly = "ok"
                                                    singlestore = "ok"
                                                    supermemory = "ok"
                                                    exa = "ok"
                                                )
                                                client.response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n" .. h
                                                client.state = "write"
                                        elseif (path == "/favicon.ico")
                                            client.response = "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\n"
                                            client.state = "write"
                                        
                                        elseif (method == "POST") and (path == "/chat")
                                            data := parse-json body
                                            if ((typeof data) == table)
                                                client.message := data @ "message" as String
                                                sid := data @ "session_id" as String
                                                use-cache := if (('key? data "use_cache")) (data @ "use_cache" as boolean) else true
                                                use-deep := if (('key? data "use_deep")) (data @ "use_deep" as boolean) else false
                                                
                                                if ((countof sid) == 0) sid = (sha512-hex "unknown")
                                                client.session-id := sid
                                                client.start-time := current-time-seconds
                                                client.step = 1
                                                client.state = "processing"
                                                client.meta @ deep = use-deep
                                                client.meta @ cached = false
                                                client.meta @ memories-used = 0
                
                elseif (client.state == "processing")
                    step := client.step
                    if (step == 1)
                        client.response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\n\r\n"
                        client.step = 2
                    elseif (step == 2)
                        msg-hash := (sha512-hex client.message)
                        cache-key := "chat:response:" .. client.session-id .. ":" .. msg-hash
                        dhost := (getenv "DRAGONFLY_HOST" "127.0.0.1")
                        dport := (atoi (getenv "DRAGONFLY_PORT" "6379"))
                        cached := redis-get dhost dport cache-key
                        if ((countof cached) > 0)

                            if ((typeof c-data) == table)
                                resp := c-data @ "response" as String
                                reas := c-data @ "reasoning" as String
                                'append client.sse-queue (SSE "content" resp)
                                if ((countof reas) > 0) 'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" reas)
                                done := (table done = true cached = true)
                                'append client.sse-queue (SSE "done" done)
                                client.step = 10
                        else
                            client.step = 3

                        if (client.meta @ deep as boolean)
                            'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" "Deep search starting...")
                            exa-data := exa-search client.message

                                        if ((countof u) > 0) 'append urls u
                            if ((countof urls) > 0)
                                cnt-data := exa-contents urls
                                ctx := cnt-data @ "context" as String
                                client.meta @ search-context = "Web Search:\n" .. ctx
                                'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" "Deep search complete.")
                            else
                                'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" "No web results.")
                            client.step = 4
                        else
                            client.step = 4
                    elseif (step == 4)
                        client.step = 5
                    elseif (step == 5)
                        msgs := (arrayof (table String String)
                            (table role = "system" content = "You are TiffyTime AI.")
                            (table role = "user" content = client.message)
                        )
                        if (('key? client.meta "search-context"))
                            sc := client.meta @ "search-context" as String
                            if ((countof sc) > 0)
                                msgs @ 0 @ content = (msgs @ 0 @ content) .. "\n\n" .. sc
                        
                        'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" "Thinking...")
                        response reasoning := cerebras-request msgs
                        elapsed := (current-time-seconds) - client.start-time
                        tokens := ((countof response) / 4)
                        
                        'append client.sse-queue (SSE "content" response)
                        if ((countof reasoning) > 0) 'append client.sse-queue (SSE "reasoning" reasoning)
                        
                        done-meta := (table
                            done = true
                            cached = false
                            elapsed_seconds = elapsed
                            approx_tokens = tokens
                            deep = (client.meta @ deep)
                        )
                        'append client.sse-queue (SSE "done" done-meta)
                        
                        dhost := (getenv "DRAGONFLY_HOST" "127.0.0.1")
                        dport := (atoi (getenv "DRAGONFLY_PORT" "6379"))
                        msg-hash := (sha512-hex client.message)
                        cache-payload := build-json (table
                            response = response
                            reasoning = reasoning
                            timestamp = (current-time-seconds)
                            memories_used = 0
                        )
                        redis-setex dhost dport ("chat:response:" .. client.session-id .. ":" .. msg-hash) 2592000 cache-payload
                        
                        shost := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_HOST" "")
                        if ((countof shost) > 0)
                            q := format "INSERT INTO chat_messages (session_id, user_message, bot_response, message_hash, cached, response_chars, elapsed_seconds) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', '{}', FALSE, {}, {})"
                                client.session-id
                                (client.message "replace" "'" "''")
                                (response "replace" "'" "''")
                                msg-hash
                                (countof response)
                                (tostring elapsed)
                            sport := (atoi (getenv "SINGLESTORE_PORT" "3306"))
                            suser := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_USER" "root")
                            spwd := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_PASSWORD" "")
                            sdb := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_DATABASE" "chatbot_db")
                            singlestore-send shost sport suser spwd sdb q
                        
                        client.step = 10
                    elseif (step == 10)
                        client.state = "write"
                
                if (client.state == "write")
                    if ((countof client.sse-queue) > 0)
                        chunk := 'popfront client.sse-queue
                        client.response ..= chunk
                    if ((countof client.response) > 0)
                        n := send fd (client.response as rawstring) (countof client.response) 0
                        if (n > 0)
                            client.response = (client.response slice n)
                    if ((countof client.response) == 0) and ((countof client.sse-queue) == 0) and (client.state == "write")
                        close fd
                        epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_DEL fd null
                        'remove clients fd

    ;

A string-contains? függvény egy alapvető substring keresést implementál manuálisan, karakterbykarakter összehasonlítással:

scopes
fn string-contains? (s sub)
    local sz : i32 = (countof s)
    local subz : i32 = (countof sub)
    if (subz == 0) return true
    if (sz < subz) return false
    loop (i)
        if (i > (sz - subz))
            return false
        if ((s @ i) == (sub @ 0))
            local j := 0
            while (j < subz)
                if ((s @ (i + j)) != (sub @ j))
                    break
                j += 1
            if (j == subz)
                return true
        i + 1


Ez a függvény kritikus szerepet játszik a HTTP kérések feldolgozásában, különösen a fejléc végének detektálásában (\r\n\r\n).

A string-trim whitespace karaktereket távolít el a string elejéről és végéről (space, tab, newline, carriage return).

A split-string egy delimitert használva feldarabolja a stringet részstringekre  ez elengedhetetlen a HTTP fejlécek és Redis válaszok feldolgozásához.

 Kriptográfiai Funkciók

scopes
fn sha512-hex (s)
    ctx := SHA512_CTX
    SHA512_Init &ctx
    SHA512_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 64)
    SHA512_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    buf := StringBuffer
    for i in (range 64)
        val := (digest @ i) as u8
        hi := (val >> 4) & 0xF
        lo := val & 0xF
        buf .. (if (hi < 10) (tostring (hi + 48)) (tostring (hi - 10 + 65)))
        buf .. (if (lo < 10) (tostring (lo + 48)) (tostring (lo - 10 + 65)))
    buf as String


A SHA512 hash függvény több célra is szolgál:
1. Session azonosítók generálása  egyedi felhasználói sessionök azonosítására
2. Cache kulcsok létrehozása  az üzenetek hashe alapján cacheeli a válaszokat
3. MySQL autentikáció  a SingleStore adatbázis kapcsolathoz jelszó hashelés

A függvény a standard C crypto libraryt használja, és hexadecimális string reprezentációt állít elő a 64 byteos hashből (128 karakteres hex string).

 3. Redis/Dragonfly Integráció

A rendszer Rediskompatibilis Dragonfly szervert használ cacheelésre és gyors adatelérésre. A RESP (REdis Serialization Protocol) implementáció manuálisan építi a parancsokat:[5]

scopes
fn redis-send (host port command args)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return ""
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return ""
    
    req := "*" .. (tostring (1 + (countof args))) .. "\r\n$" .. (tostring (countof command)) .. "\r\n" .. command .. "\r\n"
    for arg in args
        s := (arg as String)
        req ..= "$" .. (tostring (countof s)) .. "\r\n" .. s .. "\r\n"
    
    send fd (req as rawstring) (countof req) 0
    
    buf := StringBuffer
    tmp := (array i8 4096)
    loop
        n := recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 4096 0
        if (n <= 0) break
        buf .. (String (tmp as rawstring) n)
    close fd
    buf as String


A RESP protokoll arrayalapú parancsformátumot használ:
 *N\r\n  N elemű array kezdete
 $L\r\n<data>\r\n  L hosszúságú bulk string

Példa egy GET mykey parancsra:

*2\r\n$3\r\nGET\r\n$5\r\nmykey\r\n

A curl-post függvény a libcurl könyvtárat használja HTTP POST kérések küldésére:

scopes
fn curl-post (url headers body)
    curl := curl_easy_init
    if (curl == null) return ""
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_URL url
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POST 1
    header_list := curl_slist_append null "Content-Type: application/json"
    for h in headers
        header_list := curl_slist_append header_list h
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER header_list
    response-buf := StringBuffer
    fn write-callback (ptr size nmemb userdata)
        real-size := size * nmemb
        str := String (ptr as rawstring) real-size
        buf := (bitcast userdata StringBuffer)
        buf .. str
        real-size as i32
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION write-callback
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEDATA (response-buf as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS (body as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDSIZE (countof body)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_TIMEOUT 60L
    res := curl_easy_perform curl
    result := response-buf as String
    if (res != CURLE_OK) result = ""
    curl_slist_free_all header_list
    curl_easy_cleanup curl
    result

A SingleStore egy elosztott SQL adatbázis MySQLkompatibilis interfészekkel:[10]

scopes
fn mysql-build-packet (seq payload)
    len := (countof payload)
    if (len > 16777215) len := 16777215
    header := (array i8 4)
    (header @ 0) = (len & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 1) = ((len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 2) = ((len >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    (header @ 3) = (seq & 0xFF) as i8

 8. Epollalapú Webszerver Architektúra

A szerver magja egy epollalapú event loop, amely hatékonyan kezeli több ezer egyidejű kapcsolatot egyetlen szálon:[4][11][3]

scopes
fn main ()
    server-fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    opt := 1
    setsockopt server-fd SOL_SOCKET SO_REUSEADDR (opt as rawstring) (sizeof opt)
    
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons 5000
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl INADDR_ANY
    
    bind server-fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr)
    listen server-fd 128
    
    epfd := epoll_create1 0
    event := epoll_event
    event.events = EPOLLIN
    event.data.fd = server-fd
    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD server-fd event

Az epoll egy Linux kernel mechanizmus skálázható I/O eseményértesítésre:[3]

Hiányzó Funkcionalitások:

1. HTTPS támogatás  A szerver plain HTTPt használ, ami production környezetben reverse proxyt igényel (nginx, Caddy)

2. Request validáció  Nincs méretkorlát a request bodyra, potenciális DoS vektor

3. Rate limiting  Nincs védekezés spam/abuse ellen

4. Graceful shutdown  A main loop végtelen, nincs signal handler (SIGTERM/SIGINT)

5. Error logging  Nincs strukturált logging, debugging nehéz

6. Connection pooling  Minden Redis/MySQL/HTTP kérés új TCP kapcsolatot nyit, overheadet okozva

7. Health check implementáció  A /health endpoint mindig "ok"t ad vissza, nem valós health check

Performance Bottlenecks:

1. Singlethreaded  Egy CPU core kihasználtsága, worker thread pool hiánya

2. Blocking AI calls  A Cerebras/Exa hívások blokkolják az event loopot, más kliensek várakoznak

3. String concatenation  A StringBuffer . operátora potenciálisan sok allokációt végez

Biztonsági Problémák:

1. SQL injection sebezhető  A message/response escapeelés nem teljes

2. Nincs input sanitization  XSS/injection vektorok a stored databan

 15. Architektúrális Döntések Háttere

 Miért Epoll és nem Thread Pool?

Az epollalapú eventdriven architektúra előnyei:[4][3]

1. Memory efficiency  Threadek stackje (általában 28 MB) vs. kliens struktúra (~1 KB)
2. Context switch overhead  Nincs OSlevel thread switching
3. C10K problem  10,000+ egyidejű kapcsolat kezelése
4. Determinisztikus  Nincs race condition threadek között

Hátrány: CPUbound műveletek blokkolják az egész szervert. Ideális megoldás: hibrid modell worker thread poollal a longrunning műveletek offloadolásához.

 Miért Scopes és nem C/C++/Rust?

A Scopes nyelv előnyei ebben a használati esetben:[1]

1. Gyors iteráció  Compiler runtimeon marad, gyors recompile
2. C interop  libcurl, OpenSSL, libc overhead nélkül
3. Expresszív szintaxis  Schemeszerű macrok, Pythonszerű indentation
4. Zerocost abstractions  Closures, templates performance penalty nélkül
5. Multiplatform code generation  LLVM és SPIRV backend CPU és GPUhoz

 Miért Redis Cache?

A Dragonfly/Redis választás indoklása:

1. Inmemory speed  Microszekundumos latency
2. TTL support  Automatikus cache eviction
3. Persistence  Opcionális disk backing (RDB/AOF)
4. Simple protocol  RESP könnyű implementálni
5. Proven scalability  Productionready millió OPSre

 Miért ServerSent Events és nem WebSocket?

Az SSE előnyei chatbot use caseben:[8]

1. Egyszerűbb protokoll  HTTPalapú, proxyfriendly
2. Automatic reconnection  Beépített a böngészőbe
3. Egyirányú elégséges  Chatbot csak szerver→kliens streaminget igényel
4. Event ID support  Üzenet újraküldés megszakítás után
5. Textbased  Debugging és monitoring egyszerű

WebSocket akkor jobb, ha kétirányú realtime kommunikáció kell (pl. collaborative editing).
